subject.title: Feature Request: Surface API provider name in error/overload messages

question: Should transient user-facing provider errors show only provider/model context, or also broader profile/trigger context as proposed by the open linked PR?
rationale: The implementation is small, but the visible error text appears in channels like Telegram and needs a maintained privacy and supportability boundary before landing.

options.title: Land constrained transient context
options.body: Refresh the open linked PR or a replacement so overloaded/rate-limit messages include active provider/model and only approved safe context such as profile presence.

options.title: Provider-only message
options.body: Narrow the fix to the issue's original request by showing the provider name while leaving profile and trigger details out of channel-visible copy.

options.title: Keep generic copy
options.body: Leave transient user-facing errors generic and rely on logs/console metadata for provider diagnosis, accepting the existing UX ambiguity.

recommendation.title: Land constrained transient context
recommendation.body: Refresh the open linked PR or a replacement so overloaded/rate-limit messages include active provider/model and only approved safe context such as profile presence.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter is the strongest history signal across the formatter/failover area and is best positioned to decide the user-visible context boundary.
